notes.subject: חשמננים
notes.rationale: חשמנים — wanpela tok i kamap long Tanakh hia tasol; min bilong en i no klia: 'ol bikman i gat planti gutpela samting' o 'ol man i gat strongpela bodi'

notes.subject: תריץ ידיו
notes.rationale: Tok Hibru i tok olsem 'han i ran' — Tok Pisin: 'ranim ol han i go long Elohim', soim se em i go kwiktru na wantaim strong

translation: Ol bikman i gat planti gutpela samting bai ol i kamap, i kam long Mitsrayim; Kush i ranim ol han bilong en i go long Elohim.

tokens.gloss: ol bikman i gat planti gutpela samting
